prompt: In whose reign did Lehi's account in 1 Nephi begin?
explanation: The account begins in the first year of the reign of Zedekiah.

prompt: Who was Lehi's wife?
explanation: Lehi departed into the wilderness with his family, including his wife Sariah.

prompt: Which of these was NOT one of Lehi's four sons when he left Jerusalem?
explanation: Lehi's sons were Laman, Lemuel, Sam, and Nephi; Jacob was born later.

prompt: Lehi named a river after which of his sons?
explanation: Lehi called the river Laman and the valley Lemuel.

prompt: What record did Lehi send his sons back to Jerusalem to get?
explanation: The plates of brass were in the possession of Laban.

prompt: Who said, "I will go and do the things which the Lord hath commanded"?
explanation: Nephi said this to his father in 1 Nephi 3:7.

prompt: Whose voice did Nephi imitate to get the plates from Laban's treasury?
explanation: Nephi commanded the servant in the voice of Laban.

prompt: Which servant of Laban joined Lehi's family?
explanation: Zoram made an oath to tarry with them.

prompt: Whose family did Lehi's sons return to Jerusalem to bring into the wilderness?
explanation: The Lord commanded them to return and bring down Ishmael and his family.

prompt: In Lehi's dream, the fruit of the tree was desirable to make one what?
explanation: The fruit was desirable to make one happy.

prompt: In Lehi's dream, what extended along the bank of the river and led to the tree?
explanation: A rod of iron extended along the bank of the river.

prompt: What did Lehi see on the other side of the river in his dream?
explanation: He beheld a great and spacious building.

prompt: In Nephi's vision, the rod of iron represented what?
explanation: The rod of iron was the word of God.

prompt: What did Lehi find outside his tent door in the morning?
options: A round ball of curious workmanship
explanation: Lehi found a round ball of curious workmanship.

prompt: What did Nephi break while hunting, causing the family to suffer?
explanation: Nephi broke his bow, which was made of fine steel.

prompt: Who died and was buried at the place called Nahom?
explanation: Ishmael died and was buried in the place called Nahom.

prompt: What did Lehi's family call the land by the seashore where they built a ship?
explanation: They called the place Bountiful because of its much fruit.

prompt: What stopped working when Laman and Lemuel bound Nephi on the ship?
explanation: When they bound Nephi, the compass ceased to work.

prompt: 2 Nephi 2:25 teaches that "men are, that they might have" what?
explanation: Adam fell that men might be; and men are, that they might have joy.

prompt: After separating from his brothers, Nephi took his family and whom else?
options: Those who would go with him
explanation: Nephi took his family and all who would go with him.

prompt: What did Nephi build after the manner of Solomon's?
explanation: Nephi built a temple after the manner of the temple of Solomon.

prompt: Jacob taught that to be learned is good if men do what?
options: Hearken unto the counsels of God
explanation: To be learned is good if they hearken unto the counsels of God.

prompt: In 2 Nephi 25:26, Nephi says we talk, rejoice, and preach of whom?
explanation: We talk of Christ, we rejoice in Christ, we preach of Christ.

prompt: Nephi taught that even Christ was baptized. Why, according to 2 Nephi 31?
explanation: The Lamb of God was baptized to fulfil all righteousness.

prompt: Nephi counseled to "feast upon" what?
explanation: Feast upon the words of Christ, for they will tell you all things.

prompt: Jacob quoted the allegory of the olive tree from which prophet?
explanation: Jacob quoted the words of the prophet Zenos.

prompt: Who came among the Nephites in Jacob's day, denying the Christ?
explanation: There came a man named Sherem who preached that there should be no Christ.

prompt: How long did Enos pray in the forest?
options: All the day long and into the night
explanation: Enos cried unto God all the day long, and into the night.

prompt: What was Enos doing when his father's words sunk deep into his heart?
explanation: Enos went to hunt beasts in the forests.

prompt: The people of Zarahemla came out from Jerusalem when what king was carried captive?
explanation: They came out at the time Zedekiah was carried away captive into Babylon.

prompt: Which last survivor of the Jaredites was discovered by the people of Zarahemla?
explanation: They discovered Coriantumr, who lived with them nine moons.

prompt: In Words of Mormon, what did Mormon find among the records?
explanation: Mormon found these plates, which contained a small account of the prophets.

prompt: Why did King Benjamin have a tower built?
options: So the people could hear his words
explanation: The multitude was so great he caused a tower to be erected so they could hear.

prompt: King Benjamin taught that serving your fellow beings is serving whom?
explanation: When ye are in the service of your fellow beings ye are only in the service of your God.

prompt: In Mosiah 3, the angel declared the mother of Christ would be called what?
explanation: His mother shall be called Mary.

prompt: What instruments did Ammon say a seer uses to translate ancient records?
explanation: The things are called interpreters, and whosoever looks in them is a seer.

prompt: Which wicked king succeeded Zeniff?
explanation: Zeniff conferred the kingdom upon Noah, one of his sons.

prompt: Who could not be touched by King Noah's priests because the Lord protected him while he delivered his message?
explanation: The Spirit of the Lord was upon Abinadi and they durst not lay their hands on him.

prompt: Which of King Noah's priests believed Abinadi's words?
explanation: Alma believed the words Abinadi had spoken.

prompt: Near which waters did Alma baptize believers?
explanation: Alma spoke to the people at the waters of Mormon.

prompt: How many souls did Alma baptize at the waters of Mormon at that time?
explanation: About two hundred and four souls were baptized at that time.

prompt: How did Gideon's plan help Limhi's people escape the Lamanite guards?
options: The guards were given wine and became drunken
explanation: The guards drank the wine and the people escaped by the back pass.

prompt: Who appeared to Alma the younger and the sons of Mosiah?
explanation: The angel of the Lord appeared unto them as in a cloud.

prompt: Who became the first chief judge over the Nephites?
explanation: Alma was the first chief judge.

prompt: Who taught that priests should be supported by the people, and slew the aged Gideon?
explanation: Nehor slew Gideon with the sword and later suffered death for it.

prompt: Which man of Ammonihah received Alma into his house and fed him?
explanation: The man who received Alma into his house was called Amulek.

prompt: How many onties did Zeezrom offer Amulek to deny the existence of a Supreme Being?
explanation: Zeezrom offered six onties of silver.

prompt: How long had the sons of Mosiah been teaching among the Lamanites when Alma met them?
explanation: They had been teaching the word of God for the space of fourteen years.

prompt: Which Lamanite king did Ammon serve?
explanation: Ammon was carried before the king, whose name was Lamoni.

prompt: At which waters did Ammon defend the king's flocks?
explanation: The king's flocks were driven to the place of water called the water of Sebus.

prompt: Which Lamanite woman, converted many years before, ran to gather the people when the king's household fell?
explanation: Abish ran from house to house to make it known.

prompt: What did the Anti-Nephi-Lehies bury deep in the earth?
options: Their swords and weapons of war
explanation: They buried their weapons of war deep in the earth.

prompt: Which Anti-Christ came into the land of Zarahemla preaching there should be no Christ?
explanation: Korihor was an Anti-Christ.

prompt: What happened to Korihor after he asked for a sign?
explanation: Korihor was struck dumb, according to the words of Alma.

prompt: What was the Zoramites' place for prayer called?
explanation: The Zoramites called the holy stand Rameumptom.

prompt: In Alma 32, Alma compares the word to what?
explanation: Alma compares the word unto a seed.

prompt: During his three days of torment, whose prophecy about Jesus Christ did Alma remember?
explanation: Alma remembered his father prophesying of Jesus Christ.

prompt: What was the ball or director called by Lehi's people?
explanation: Our fathers called it Liahona, which is a compass.

prompt: Alma counseled his son Shiblon to use boldness but not what?
explanation: Use boldness, but not overbearance.

prompt: To which land had Corianton gone after the harlot Isabel?
explanation: Corianton went over into the land of Siron after the harlot Isabel.

prompt: Who was appointed chief captain of the Nephite armies at age twenty-five?
explanation: Moroni was only twenty and five years old when appointed chief captain.

prompt: On what did Captain Moroni write the title of liberty?
explanation: He rent his coat and wrote upon it.

prompt: Who sought to be king and led a dissension that prompted the title of liberty?
explanation: Amalickiah was desirous to be a king.

prompt: Who slew Amalickiah in his tent with a javelin?
explanation: Teancum put a javelin to Amalickiah's heart.

prompt: How many young men did Helaman lead in Alma 53?
explanation: Two thousand young men entered into this covenant.

prompt: Who taught the stripling warriors that God would deliver them?
explanation: They had been taught by their mothers.

prompt: How many of Helaman's stripling warriors were slain in the battle of Alma 57?
explanation: To our great astonishment, there was not one soul of them who did perish.

prompt: What were those who wanted to overthrow free government and establish a king called?
explanation: Those who desired a king were called king-men.

prompt: Who built exceedingly large ships and launched them into the west sea?
explanation: Hagoth built an exceedingly large ship.

prompt: Who was the founder of the band that became known as Gadianton robbers?
explanation: Gadianton was exceedingly expert in many words.

prompt: According to Helaman 5:12, we must build our foundation upon whose rock?
explanation: Build your foundation upon the rock of our Redeemer.

prompt: What encircled Nephi and Lehi in the Lamanite prison?
explanation: Nephi and Lehi were encircled about as if by fire.

prompt: Where was Nephi praying when people gathered to see him in Helaman 7?
options: On a tower in his garden
explanation: Nephi was on a tower in his garden by the highway.

prompt: Whose murder did Nephi reveal through prophecy in Helaman 9?
explanation: Nephi revealed the chief judge was murdered.

prompt: Where did Samuel the Lamanite stand to prophesy to the Nephites?
options: On the steps of the judgment seat
On a hill outside the city
Upon a tower in the temple
Upon the wall of the city
explanation: Samuel went and got upon the wall thereof.

prompt: How many years did Samuel say until the Son of God would come?
explanation: Samuel said: five years more cometh, and then cometh the Son of God.

prompt: What sign of Christ's birth did Samuel prophesy concerning the night?
options: No darkness for a day, a night, and a day
explanation: There shall be no darkness for a day, a night, and a day.

prompt: What arose at Christ's birth, according to the sign?
explanation: A new star did appear, according to the word.

prompt: How long did the darkness last after Christ's death in 3 Nephi 8?
explanation: It did last for the space of three days.

prompt: How did the resurrected Christ come to the people at Bountiful?
options: Descending out of heaven clothed in a white robe
explanation: They saw a Man descending out of heaven, clothed in a white robe.

prompt: Near which temple were the people gathered when Christ appeared?
options: The temple in the land Bountiful
explanation: The people were gathered round about the temple in the land Bountiful.

prompt: Whom did the resurrected Christ first call forth and give power to baptize?
explanation: The Lord commanded Nephi to come forth.

prompt: What did Jesus do with the little children one by one in 3 Nephi 17?
options: Blessed them and prayed for them
explanation: He took their little children, one by one, and blessed them.

prompt: How many disciples did Jesus choose among the Nephites?
explanation: Jesus spoke of the twelve He had chosen from among the multitude.

prompt: Whose prophecy did Jesus ask to be added to the Nephite records?
explanation: Jesus asked about Samuel the Lamanite's words not being written.

prompt: What did three of the Nephite disciples desire of the Lord?
options: To remain until He comes again
explanation: The three would never taste of death until the Lord comes.

prompt: How did the people share their goods after Christ's visit?
explanation: They had all things common among them.

prompt: Why was there no contention in the land in 4 Nephi?
options: The love of God dwelt in their hearts
explanation: There was no contention because of the love of God.

prompt: About how old was Mormon when Ammaron told him about the records?
explanation: Mormon was about ten years of age.

prompt: In which year of his life did Mormon go at the head of a Nephite army?
explanation: In his sixteenth year Mormon went forth at the head of an army against the Lamanites.

prompt: Where did Mormon ask the Lamanite king to gather for the final battle?
explanation: Mormon wrote to gather unto the land of Cumorah.

prompt: Who finished his father Mormon's record?
explanation: I, Moroni, do finish the record of my father, Mormon.

prompt: The Jaredites came from which great tower?
options: The great tower at the confusion of tongues
explanation: Jared and his brother came from the great tower.

prompt: How many vessels (barges) had the Jaredites prepared when the brother of Jared went up mount Shelem?
explanation: The number of the vessels which had been prepared was eight.

prompt: How many stones did the brother of Jared bring to the Lord to be touched?
explanation: He did molten out of a rock sixteen small stones.

prompt: What did the brother of Jared see when the Lord touched the stones?
explanation: He saw the finger of the Lord.

prompt: How many days were the Jaredites on the water?
explanation: They were driven forth three hundred and forty and four days upon the water.

prompt: According to Ether 12:6, we receive no witness until after what?
explanation: Ye receive no witness until after the trial of your faith.

prompt: According to Ether 12:27, God gives men weakness that they may be what?
explanation: I give unto men weakness that they may be humble.

prompt: Which Jaredite king fought Coriantumr until only the two of them remained?
explanation: Coriantumr smote off the head of Shiz.

prompt: In Moroni 4, who administers the sacramental bread?
explanation: It is the manner of elders and priests administering.

prompt: Mormon defines charity as what?
explanation: Charity is the pure love of Christ.

prompt: In Moroni 10:4, we are to ask God the Eternal Father in whose name?
explanation: Ask God, the Eternal Father, in the name of Christ.

prompt: By what power may we know the truth of all things, according to Moroni 10:5?
explanation: By the power of the Holy Ghost ye may know the truth of all things.

prompt: Mormon taught little children are whole and do not need what?
explanation: Little children are whole; they need no repentance or baptism.

prompt: Jesus said the sacrament bread was done in remembrance of what?
explanation: This shall ye do in remembrance of my body.

prompt: King Benjamin said his people would be called the children of whom?
explanation: Ye shall be called the children of Christ.

prompt: What order did Alma say many were ordained to?
explanation: Many were ordained unto the high priesthood of the holy order of God.

prompt: According to Alma 41:10, wickedness never was what?
explanation: Wickedness never was happiness.

prompt: King Benjamin warned that a man should not run faster than what?
explanation: It is not requisite that a man should run faster than he has strength.

prompt: The Amlicites marked themselves with what?
explanation: The Amlicites had marked themselves with red in their foreheads.

prompt: Jarom was the son of whom?
explanation: I, Jarom, write according to the commandment of my father, Enos.
